title: US Senate fails to advance CLARITY Act
summary: The failed procedural vote leaves the CLARITY Act facing an uncertain future after months of negotiations over crypto oversight and ethics provisions.

title: Stablecoin growth could boost dollar dominance, US Treasury demand: BoE official
summary: A Bank of England policy maker said digital dollars could expand access to the US currency while turning stablecoin issuers into bigger buyers of government debt.

title: Binance adds 11 US-listed ETFs to wealth management offering
summary: The crypto exchange is expanding its traditional finance offerings with 11 US-listed exchange-traded funds focused on US Treasurys and investment-grade bonds.

title: Bitcoin price falls to $75.6K September low as global bonds hit multidecade highs
summary: Bitcoin price action weakened over market nerves prior to the Senate CLARITY Act vote, while surging bond yields pressured risk assets across the board.

title: Standard Chartered says Arbitrum could outperform Bitcoin, Ether through 2030
summary: Standard Chartered sees Robinhood Chain as an early sign that tokenization could transform Arbitrum’s economics and drive ARB sharply higher by 2030.

title: ETH wallet exploit backfires as MEV bot captures $7.7M, Kelp freezes address
summary: An MEV bot known as “Yoink” front-ran an attacker attempting to exploit a custom Safe module, capturing the stolen rsETH before Kelp temporarily froze the receiving address.

title: USDT payments feature in Polish energy giant’s failed $230M oil deal: FT
summary: Tether’s USDT stablecoin was part of a failed oil trade that reportedly cost a Polish energy giant $230 million in late 2023.

title: US House crypto tax package omits mining, staking reward deferral
summary: The 114-page bill would change the tax treatment of crypto fees, stablecoins and lending while leaving existing reward-tax timing unchanged.

title: Ethereum, Base wallet standards talks fail, Ethlabs researcher says
summary: Ethereum and Base are pursuing different account abstraction designs after talks failed, according to Ethlabs researcher Derek Chiang.

title: Bitcoin short-term holders hit 30-day profit streak as bull-market odds improve: CryptoQuant
summary: Bitcoin short-term holders approached a full month in partial profit as analysis saw improving odds of an enduring bullish BTC price reversal.
